scripts.build: npm run build:browser && npm run build:addon
scripts.deploy:addon: npm run build:addon && npx tsx renderer/html2slides/addon/deploy.ts
scripts.regen: npm run regen:basics && npm run regen:complex
scripts.rate:basics: lsof -ti:3456 | xargs -r kill; npx tsx renderer/html2slides/rating-server.ts /tmp/sxs --port 3456
scripts.rate:complex: lsof -ti:3457 | xargs -r kill; npx tsx renderer/html2slides/rating-server.ts /tmp/sxs-complex --port 3457
scripts.rate: lsof -ti:3456,3457 | xargs -r kill; npm run rate:basics & npm run rate:complex
